cases.text:
Morning checks a cracked sill.
By dusk, salt has filmed the basin.

Item: heather clamp / Place: shelf nine
Item: violet washer / Place: tray four
Item: amber collar / Place: drawer six
Item: quartz pin / Place: bin one

The bell held its breath at low tide.
The bell held its breath while the quay emptied.
The bell held its breath until the rope came loose.
The score marks “hinge clicks in the dark” as a refrain, but this excerpt supplies only that occurrence.
